description: S457 4a — a handler expression followed by `>` after a space is refused: the `>` closes the tag, so `@big = @n > 1` compiled to `@big = @n` with ` 1>go` leaking into the body, at exit 0.
rationale: §5.2 "An unquoted value is read WHOLE": "an event-handler EXPRESSION … followed by `>` after inline whitespace … is E-ATTR-UNQUOTED-OPERATOR" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 4).
